correctness.rationale: The standard Abrams cubical unordered two-point model is valid for the simple octahedral graph under the two-particle subdivision condition. Independent reconstruction gives 15 zero-cells, 48 one-cells, 30 two-cells; all integer cubical boundaries compose to zero. Independent exact rational elimination gives rank ∂1=14, rank ∂2=26, hence Betti (1,8,4). The four opposite triangular-face pairs give embedded products of edge cycles and therefore four closed 2-chains. Their pairwise unique square coordinates yield an explicit 4x4 diagonal unit minor, so they span a primitive rank-four sublattice of C2; since ker∂2 is saturated and rank4, these cycles form an integral basis of H2≅Z4. An independent construction of all four torus cycles found pairwise exclusive square-support witness coordinates (1,7,6,2), with diagonal signs (-1,-1,1,1), certifying the integral unit minor. A fresh signed fixed-cell Euler calculation for all 48 octahedral graph automorphisms independently verified the H1 character formula; the inspected source also computes the H2 representation. Geometrically group action permutes four opposite face pairs and reverses product orientation under central inversion, yielding H2=(1⊕S^(3,1))⊗ε. The equivariant chain Euler identity gives H1=(sgn⊕S^(2,1,1))⊗(1⊕ε); the absence of full-group invariants in H1,H2 gives rationally acyclic quotient after barycentric subdivision. No integral H1 torsion claim or contractible quotient claim is made.
